Joan: Kickoff for Meridian Health pilot. Scope: streaming SDK (Python), function/tool-calls returning strict JSON, SAML SSO, KMS for PHI, and dedicated capacity estimate. Who can lead SDK + perf?
Ravi: I can take SDK samples and perf harness. Will prioritize Python.
Elena: I'll handle security questionnaire and attach SOC2 + KMS flow. Need their IdP metadata.
Chris: For SSO we have SP metadata template. @Joan please upload IdP XML. Capacity note: target p50 <200ms at 45 rps, spikes to 180.
Joan: IdP XML and questionnaire draft uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/meridian/poc.
PresalesBot: Created POC ticket POC-7812. Owners: Joan, Ravi. Due: 2026-05-05.
Ravi: Small Python streaming + tool-call snippet for demo harness and a schema validator will be included. Will run perf today and post results.
Elena: I'll attach KMS diagram and ping Legal for DPA.
Joan: Acceptance criteria: 1) streaming demo with validated JSON; 2) p50 <200ms at 45 rps; 3) SAML E2E; 4) DPA + SOC2 on file. Proposed demo Wed 11am PT.
Chris: Drafting provisional dedicated commit estimate; will refine after perf.
Joan: Thanks all — please keep updates here so I can coordinate with customer.
